description: This file defines the Currency class for handling currency conversions, formatting, and related utilities within the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM application. It includes methods for converting to/from USD, retrieving default currency settings, and generating currency-related dropdowns.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Encapsulates currency conversion, formatting, and retrieval functions for SuiteCRM/SugarCRM.

methods.name: convertToDollar
methods.description: Converts a currency amount to USD based on the conversion rate.

methods.name: convertFromDollar
methods.description: Converts a USD amount to the target currency using the conversion rate.

methods.name: getDefaultCurrencyName
methods.description: Returns the default currency name from system configuration.

methods.name: getDefaultCurrencySymbol
methods.description: Returns the default currency symbol from system configuration.

methods.name: getDefaultISO4217
methods.description: Returns the default ISO 4217 currency code.

methods.name: retrieveIDBySymbol
methods.description: Fetches the currency ID for a given symbol if not marked as deleted.

methods.name: list_view_parse_additional_sections
methods.description: Adds merge checkbox in list view if applicable.

methods.name: retrieve_id_by_name
methods.description: Fetches the currency ID by name.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves currency data by ID, or initializes default if ID is -99.

methods.name: getPdfCurrencySymbol
methods.description: Returns the currency symbol suitable for PDFs, with special handling for Euro.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares list view data, formatting conversion rate.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Clears currency cache and saves the currency object.
